test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Deny
solution:
The correct answer is** Accept**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Deny means to refuse to allow somebody to have something.

 -Example: She was denied permission to remain in the country.

 
• Marked option Accept means to agree to take something that somebody offers you.

 -Example: Thank you for your invitation. I am happy to accept.

So, it is clear that Deny and Accept are opposite in meaning.

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Block means to prevent something from happening or succeeding.
 
• Prevent means to stop something from happening or to stop somebody from doing something.
 
• Check means to examine or test something in order to make sure that it is safe or correct, in good condition, etc.
